title: GPT-6 Astra adds asynchronous tools and mid-task steering
friendlyTitle: OpenAI’s new model can use tools while other work continues
summary: OpenAI is rolling GPT-6 Astra out first through its Trusted Access Program, with broader API and ChatGPT access planned in the following days. For developers, the important additions include asynchronous tool calls, mid-turn instructions and reasoning-effort changes that preserve prompt caching.
friendlySummary: GPT-6 Astra can keep working while a slow tool runs, accept new instructions during a task and change how hard it thinks without rebuilding the whole conversation.
whyItMatters: These features address ordinary agent problems: waiting on slow tools, correcting a job without restarting it and controlling cost as task difficulty changes. Teams migrating should also note that tool use requires the Responses API and several older generation parameters are unsupported.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This can make AI helpers faster and easier to correct. Developers will need to update some API settings before moving existing products to the model.
